channel.title: The Car Jury, News
channel.description: News and verdicts on the Indian car market from The Car Jury.

item.title: Kia Carens Clavis gets up to Rs 1.2 lakh off in August 2026
item.description: Kia Carens Clavis MPV gets benefits up to Rs 1.2 lakh in August 2026, with MY25 stock carrying the fattest cash discounts. Details inside.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: Audi India commits to three locally assembled launches by 2027
item.description: Audi India will launch the Q3, A5 and Q9 by 2027, all locally assembled at the Aurangabad plant. Q3 lands first at around Rs 60 lakh.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: SIAM Retreats On E20 Contamination Warning: Buyers Left Holding The Bag
item.description: SIAM has withdrawn its E20 fuel contamination communication to the petroleum ministry, citing selective media quoting and figures needing verification.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: MG Hector, Hector Plus Get Up To Rs 51,000 Costlier From August 2026
item.description: JSW MG Motor has hiked MG Hector and Hector Plus prices by up to Rs 50,800 from August 2026, though the Rs 11.99 lakh entry price stays put.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: Mahindra XUV 7XO Long Drive Review: The Mass-Market Luxury SUV Finally Grows Up
item.description: After 1,500 km across Maharashtra and Karnataka in the XUV 7XO Diesel AT AWD, The Car Jury delivers its verdict on Mahindra's flagship SUV.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: JSW-Skoda VW JV: The Lifeline Volkswagen Group India Actually Needs
item.description: JSW Group and Skoda Auto Volkswagen India are close to a 51:49 manufacturing JV MoU that will fund EVs and deepen localisation.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: Tata Holds The EV Crown As VinFast Crashes Into India's Top 5
item.description: Tata leads India's EV sales in July 2026 with 15,055 units. MG reclaims second, Mahindra slips, VinFast breaks into the top five.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: Nissan Tekton Bags India Book Of Records With 60-SUV Convoy To Leh
item.description: Nissan Tekton entered the India Book of Records with a 60-SUV convoy from Chandigarh to Leh, covering 700+ km through Shinku La at 16,703 feet.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: Kia Sorento Lands 4 September: The Fortuner Fighter Kia Should Have Sent Years Ago
item.description: Kia Sorento launches in India on 4 September 2026 with hybrid and diesel powertrains, taking on Fortuner, Kodiaq, Meridian and MG Majestor.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: Hyundai's 1,671 service touchpoints: the boring moat that beats Honda's ghost
item.description: Hyundai India's service network now spans 1,671 touchpoints across 1,021 cities, with 8.23 million vehicles serviced in FY26. Our verdict for buyers.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: MG Hector Hawk lands August 28: EV + PHEV 7-seater on new ADAPT platform
item.description: JSW MG will launch the Hector Hawk on August 28, a 7-seater built on the new ADAPT platform with EV and PHEV powertrains taking on Mahindra XEV 9S.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: Hyundai's 60% Creta Electric buyback is the honest EV pitch India needed
item.description: Hyundai promises 60% buyback on the Creta Electric for 3 years or 45,000km. The Car Jury on whether this fixes the EV resale problem.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: E20 Fuel Contamination Is Wrecking Engines: SIAM Demands Chloride Limits
item.description: SIAM flags chloride and moisture contamination in E20 petrol as fuel injectors and pumps fail. The Centre orders tighter monitoring at retail outlets.
item.author: noreply@thecarjury.com (Rajat Dewasi)

item.title: Jeep Meridian gets Rs 1.65 lakh off in August 2026, Compass up to Rs 1.5 lakh
